nodes.title: Using this workflow
widgets_values: Upload an opening guide and title artwork. Edit the hook, stakes and choice scenes, then set the title, byline, closing invitation and narrator line. After the three scenes play, the title card holds for four seconds. One generated score sits under the dialogue and spoken title.

widgets_values_named.text: Upload an opening guide and title artwork. Edit the hook, stakes and choice scenes, then set the title, byline, closing invitation and narrator line. After the three scenes play, the title card holds for four seconds. One generated score sits under the dialogue and spoken title.

nodes.title: Hook - a light goes out
widgets_values:
Follow the opening guide. A lighthouse beam sweeps a fogbound channel, flickers, then vanishes. End on the dark water.
$dialogue $speech_limit Natural synchronized voices. Use ambient sound only. Keep the image free of text.

nodes.title: Compose instrumental score
widgets_values: Begin with a faint bowed note and a slow pulse. Widen into an open chord as the lighthouse beam returns. Keep the score instrumental and quiet under the voices.
